messages.subject: NIMBLE version 1.4.1 released
parts:
We've released version 1.4.1 of nimble.

This is a micro release that primarily addresses some minor issues, but it also includes:

 - An MCMC sampler for sampling elements of partially observed multivariate normal random variables, e.g., if one has some elements of a data vector that are missing.
 - The ability to change the MCMC thinning interval when continuing an MCMC.

Please see the NEWS file in the installed package for more details.

- Chris Paciorek for the NIMBLE Development Team
